dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK, class. What would you do if you won ten million baht?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, ˈklæs. ˈwʌt wʊd juː ˈduː ɪf juː ˈwʌn ˈtɛn ˈmɪljən ˈbɑːt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd invest some of the money.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ɪnˈvɛst sʌm əv ðə ˈmʌni.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Would you put it in the stock market?
dialogue.reading: wʊd juː ˈpʊt ɪt ɪn ðə ˈstɑːk ˌmɑːrkɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I don't know much about the stock market. I'd buy property, like a small apartment.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ ˈmʌtʃ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈstɑːk ˌmɑːrkɪt. aɪd ˈbaɪ ˈprɑːpərti, laɪk ə ˈsmɔːl əˈpɑːrtmənt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good idea. And what would you do, Emma? Would you buy a sports car?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ənd ˈwʌt wʊd juː ˈduː, ˈɛmə? wʊd juː ˈbaɪ ə ˈspɔːrts ˌkɑːr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No way! If I had a sports car, where would I drive it? The traffic in Bangkok is terrible!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈweɪ! ɪf aɪ ˈhæd ə ˈspɔːrts ˌkɑːr, ˈwɛr wʊd aɪ ˈdraɪv ɪt? ðə ˈtræfɪk ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ˈtɛrəbəl!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ha! You're right. Would you still work if you had that much money?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! jʊr ˈraɪt. wʊd juː ˈstɪl ˈwɜːrk ɪf juː ˈhæd ðæt ˈmʌtʃ ˈmʌni?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, I would. I'd get bored at home.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈwʊd. aɪd ˈɡɛt ˈbɔːrd ət ˈhoʊm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What about you, Nam? Would you retire?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt juː, ˈnɑːm? wʊd juː rɪˈtaɪər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Retire? I'm too young! But I'd take a year off and travel.
dialogue.reading: rɪˈtaɪər? aɪm ˈtuː ˈjʌŋ! bʌt aɪd ˈteɪk ə ˈjɪr ˈɔːf ənd ˈtrævəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That sounds great. I think I'd retire!
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈɡreɪt. aɪ ˈθɪŋk aɪd rɪˈtaɪər!
